evaluation.note: Source-dataset evaluation only; this does not establish real-world webcam accuracy.

ui_vocabulary.note: Both application modes derive recognition labels from the loaded checkpoint; the curated demo catalog only controls reference videos.

training_data_safety.basis: dataset.py builds train/val/test arrays only from data/subset_*.csv and data/landmarks; it does not read data/self_recorded.
